rationale: The happy path. A well-matched résumé and JD should produce a letter that actually uses the résumé's concrete achievements rather than generic enthusiasm, and that obeys the humanizer rules the prompt encodes.

Adversarial for style rather than facts: a fintech JD full of the exact register that pulls models toward AI-tell vocabulary — passionate, thrilled, leverage, robust, seamless, spearheaded. The prompt bans these and humanize() strips em dashes and emoji afterwards; this measures how much correcting the model actually needed.

Adversarial: an almost-empty junior résumé against a senior JD. A cover letter has no groundedIn backstop the way tailoring does, so this is the only place fabrication is caught. The model must write a short honest letter rather than inventing a career.
